items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution for design and UX work this cycle. No new implementation is queue-eligible because active measurement, failed requests, ownership, validation, rollback, security, attribution, and release gates remain incomplete. Preserve deferred scopes for 0xroulette.com, allthingsmasonic.com, greatamericanlakes.com, broadwayshowgirls.com, blackmarketapparel.com, marineactivity.com, and saveusfarms.com. Reconsider only after existing work is measured or repaired with preview evidence, deterministic tests, accessibility checks, metric definition, and rollback evidence. Do not create or requeue production work, add telemetry, deploy, spend, or claim conversion lift.
